body.value:
from(bucket: "existenzApi")
  |> range(start: 2019-12-30T00:00:00Z, stop: 2020-01-03T00:50:00.000001Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "hydro")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["loc"] == "2135")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "flow" or r["_field"] == "flow_ls" or r["_field"] == "height_abs" or r["_field"] == "height" or r["_field"] == "temperature")
  |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_value", "_field", "_measurement", "loc"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time", "_field"])
